nativeBaseline.reference: Dialog-based native modal surface exposed with alertdialog semantics

library: provide alertdialog semantics, deterministic title/description relationships, native modality, initial focus, and focus restoration
prevent backdrop dismissal while preserving the Dialog dismissal/controlled-state contract
consumer: author localized consequence, recovery, cancel, and action content appropriate to the real risk
own destructive transaction truth, authorization, reauthentication, approval, undo/recovery, and backend enforcement

notes: AlertDialog inherits Dialog-class modality and focus behavior while strengthening the decision semantics and backdrop policy.
Automated role/name/focus assertions do not establish screen-reader interoperability for the modal decision experience.
